title: Fluid and Weight Conversions
content:
It is recommended to memorize all common fluid and weight conversions, even those that can be derived, to save time.

  • 1 gallon = 4 quarts = 16 cups = 128 oz = 231 in³
  • 1 quart = 2 pints
  • 1 pint = 2 cups
  • 1 cup = 8 oz
  • 1 tbsp = 0.5 oz
  • 1 tsp = 1/6 oz
  • 1 pound = 16 oz
  • 1 ton = 2000 lbs
summary: It is recommended to memorize all common fluid and weight conversions, even those that can be derived, to save time.
